title: The ground truth fails its own verifier: its circular debt schedule was cached before it converged, so no output can pass
evidence: The only verifier (weight 1, all-or-nothing) recalculates the agent's output in LibreOffice and requires every modification cell to match the GT's cached values within 1%. I put the unmodified GT file through verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells with the spec parameters and it scored 0.0: 'FAILED - regression 1.0000, modification 0.4211. 17 cell error(s)'. All 17 errors are in the circular LBO debt schedule. On 'LBO & Lenders', interest T53 = T54*AVERAGE(T49,T51), amortization T50 = T53-T52, and ending balance T51 = SUM(T49:T50). The cached GT values break this identity. T53 is cached at 118.970, but 0.1275*AVG(938.6856, 931.1912) = 119.205. The error grows each year: X50 GT -16.826 vs LibreOffice -12.781 (24% apart), X53 109.638 vs 113.684, T50 -7.494 vs -7.260 (3%). These cells feed MOIC R62 (GT 3.7428 vs 3.7249) and IRR R63. The agent's file gets the same LibreOffice recalculation, so even a perfect fix produces the converged values and fails. Every tested input (the GT itself, the untouched input, the GT with one extra fix) scores 0.
confirmation: gt_07_golden.xlsx 'LBO & Lenders' T49:X53 caches unconverged circular values. For example X53 is cached at 109.64, but X54*AVERAGE(X49,X51) = 113.36, and X50 is -16.83 against about -12.78 once converged, which is far outside the 1% tolerance after the verifier's LibreOffice recalculation. All 3 tri
fix: Same GT re-cache as verifier-correctness-0 (converged circular-loop values on 'LBO & Lenders').

Passing gt_07_golden.xlsx through that same recalculation and comparison produces regression=1.0000, modification=0.4211 and 17 cell errors, yielding a score of zero. Mandatory recalculation changes X53 to 113.683548936339 and X50 from -16.8263732189333 to -12.7810638582942. Thus even the supplied answer workbook does not reproduce the graded answers.

title: Golden gate: the ground-truth deliverable does not score full reward
evidence: The ground-truth deliverable, staged at the verifiers' own output paths and graded by the problem's real grader, scored 0.00 (need >= 1.00). A correct answer that does not earn full reward means a verifier false-negatives the mandated work. With the ground truth staged, every one of the 1 checks on /home/model/Desktop/output.xlsx scored 0 (summed weight 1.000), which is the whole shortfall of the GT grade. A correct deliverable does not fail every check at once; the ground truth for this file most likely never reached the grader (paired with a file of another type or name), so these are not 1 separate verifier defects. Checks: SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check.
confirmation: The GT really does not score full reward. The cause is the unconverged circular cache, not a missing file: gt_07_golden.xlsx 'LBO & Lenders' T49:X53 caches unconverged circular values. fix: Same GT re-cache as verifier-correctness-0 (converged circular-loop values on 'LBO & Lenders').

title: SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check: verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells force-recalculates only output_path in LibreOffice while reading unconverged Excel cached values from gt_path and reference_path, causing even the golden workbook to score 0.0
evidence: In verifiers/spreadsheetbench2.py:362-369, verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells (weight: 1) runs `managed_recalculated_xlsx(Path(output_path), force_recalculation=True, model_deliverable=True)` on the agent's output workbook, but passes raw `Path(reference_path)` and `Path(gt_path)` directly to `score_workbooks` without recalculating them in LibreOffice. The workbook contains an iterative circular debt/interest schedule in `LBO & Lenders!T49:X59` (`T50 = T53 - T52`, `T51 = SUM(T49:T50)`, `T53 = T54 * AVERAGE(T49, T51)`). In `gt_07_golden.xlsx`, the cached values in `T49:X59` are not converged (for example, in column U, `U49 = 931.19119`, `U51 = 922.16383`, `U54 = 0.1275`, so `U54 * AVERAGE(U49, U51)` is `118.15138`, whereas `gt_07_golden.xlsx` caches `U53 = 117.43726` and `U50 = -9.02736`). When `verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells` is run with `output_path` set to `gt_07_golden.xlsx` itself, LibreOffice recalculates the circular schedule and the golden file FAILS against itself with `score=0.0` (`FAILED - regression 1.0000, modification 0.4211. 17 cell error(s): Modification error at LBO & Lenders!T50: answer=-7.49437449150413, output=-7.25996975435565; Modification error at LBO & Lenders!U50: answer=-9.02735612840306, output=-8.29828677938158; Modification error at LBO & Lenders!V50: answer=-11.0419533184794, output=-9.5312270856202; Regression error at LBO & Lenders!V53: answer=115.422659476154, output=116.933385709013...`). Every unit (Units 1, 2, and 3) failed on these exact `LBO & Lenders!T50:X58` cells because LibreOffice-recalculated outputs cannot match the unconverged cached values in `gt_07_golden.xlsx`.
confirmation: gt_07_golden.xlsx 'LBO & Lenders' T49:X53 caches unconverged circular values. For example X53 is cached at 109.64, but X54*AVERAGE(X49,X51) = 113.36, and X50 is -16.83 against about -12.78 once converged, which is far outside the 1% tolerance after the verifier's LibreOffice recalculation. All 3 tri
fix: files/gt/gt_07_golden.xlsx: cached values of 38 cells on 'LBO & Lenders' (the circular debt block T49:X59 and R63) replaced with the converged LibreOffice values (LibreOffice recalculated it 12 times until nothing moved, e.g. X53 109.64 -> 114.39, X50 -16.83 -> -12.07). No formula changed and no other sheet changed. The circular debt-schedule cells that do not settle in one LibreOffice recalculation (X46:X47, S49:X51, S53:X53, S57:X59 on 'LBO & Lenders', the same block as sibling task <id>) are left out of answer_position and the guidance range text, so an openpyxl-saved output no longer drifts. Real SB2 scorer: golden 1.0, golden re-saved with openpyxl 1.0, input + key formulas saved with openpyxl 1.0, untouched input fails (mod 0.0).
